author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices five-finger scales, counting fa-las, long-short rhythm, A-A-B-A song shape and two-hand teamwork, with a Welsh New Year tune.

classes.title: Five stairs down to C
classes.goal: Find the five-finger place on C and walk down the stairs: 5, 4, 3, 2, 1.

mathTarget.parentLine: Counting down the fingers, five to one

classes.parentPrompt: Help the thumb find C, left of the two black keys; count down: 5, 4, 3, 2, 1.
classes.childAction: Put five fingers on C to G, then walk down from 5 to 1.
classes.bridge: Each finger is a stair in the hall; walk down from the top, G, to C.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding the hand's place and counting fingers down.

classes.title: Count the fa-las
classes.goal: Play the 'fa la la' answer and count its sounds: five, then four.

mathTarget.parentLine: Counting the sounds: five fa-las, then four

classes.parentPrompt: Sing 'fa la la la la', holding up a finger per sound, then 'la la la la'.
classes.childAction: Sing and count the fa-las: five, then four.
classes.bridge: Fa-la-la is five quick hops, then four more to land home.

intro.caption: Five fa-las, then four
intro.parentCue: hold up one finger for each sound

games.caption: Listen: five fa-las, then four
games.parentCue: Hold up a finger on each sound

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting the sounds in a line.

classes.title: Same, same, new, same
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and spot the one line that is different.

mathTarget.parentLine: Three lines match; one new line sits in the middle

classes.parentPrompt: After each line, ask: same or new? Cheer when 'Don we now' arrives. Sing stuck words.
classes.childAction: Play slowly and spot the one new line.
classes.bridge: Three lines are the same holly branch; 'Don we now' is a shiny new ornament.

intro.caption: Same, same, new, same
intro.parentCue: ask after each line: same or new?

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: spotting which lines repeat and which is new.

classes.title: Long, short, deck the halls
classes.goal: Play the long-short start of 'Deck the halls' slowly and evenly.

mathTarget.parentLine: One long note that lasts three times a short one

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'lo-o-ong, short' on the first two notes, then 'walk' on the rest; go slow first.
classes.childAction: Hold G long, quick F, then walk down evenly.
classes.bridge: Deck is a long, proud step; the is a tiny hop; then we walk.

intro.caption: Lo-o-ong, short, walk, walk
intro.parentCue: say it with the notes, nice and slow

games.caption: Deck the halls, slowly
games.parentCue: Say 'lo-o-ong, short' on the first two

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing long-short rhythms evenly.

classes.title: Low C, same name
classes.goal: Play one low left-hand note at the start of each bar while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same note name lives lower on the left

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune while your child plays the low notes. Count bars out loud: one, two, three.
classes.childAction: Play one low note with your left hand at each 'one'.
classes.bridge: Low C is the same name in the basement, far to the left.

games.caption: Same name, lower house
games.parentCue: Point left on each low C

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing low notes with the left hand.

classes.title: One-two-three-four
classes.goal: Keep the left-hand notes going at full speed, landing on each 'one'.

mathTarget.parentLine: Each bar has four beats; the low note lands on one

classes.parentPrompt: Count one-two-three-four with each bar, loud on one. Keep going if notes slip.
classes.childAction: Play your low note on every big one, then wait three beats.
classes.bridge: Four steps round the hall; the low note is the first big stomp.

intro.caption: Low note on one
intro.parentCue: count loud on one, soft on two, three, four

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: landing on the first beat of each bar.

classes.title: Two hands, two jobs
classes.goal: Play the tune with a low left-hand note at the start of each bar, very slowly.

mathTarget.parentLine: One low note for every four beats of tune

classes.parentPrompt: Rest a hand on your child's left shoulder and say 'low' on each bar. Go very slowly.
classes.childAction: Right hand plays the tune; left hand plays one low note each bar.
classes.bridge: The left hand is the steady floor; the right hand dances on top.

intro.caption: Two hands, two jobs
intro.parentCue: say 'low' on each bar, very slowly

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing two hands with two different jobs.

classes.title: Slow halls, quicker halls
classes.goal: Play both hands a little faster, and go back to slow when notes fall apart.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same song, only the speed changes

classes.parentPrompt: Listen together to slow, then quicker; go back to slow if it gets messy.
classes.childAction: Play slowly, then a bit faster, the very same notes.
classes.bridge: A slow walk and a quick march go down the same hall.

intro.caption: Same song, a little faster
intro.parentCue: go back to slow whenever needed

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping a song together at two speeds.

classes.title: March with the music
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music at full speed.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping up with a beat that does not wait

classes.parentPrompt: Sit beside your child and nod on every one; cheer for keeping going, not for notes.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music and keep going, even after a slip.
classes.bridge: The music is a big parade through the hall; keep marching past bumps.

intro.caption: March along and keep going
intro.parentCue: nod on every one and smile at slips

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping up with the music together.

classes.title: Fa-la-la concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy while the family sings the fa-las.

mathTarget.parentLine: One part sings the line, everyone answers

classes.parentPrompt: Seat teddy as the audience; sing every 'fa la la' loudly together, then bow.
classes.childAction: Play for teddy while everyone sings fa-la-la, then bow.
classes.bridge: The tune tells the line; the whole family answers with a silly fa-la-la.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song with a family chorus.
